title: Azusawa Kohane — To Future Me〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Airport

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(We're already going back to Japan...
This trip ended up going by so fast.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. This is what we saw when we all got off the plane.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, no...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Sorry, An, but I'd like to take a photo.
Would that be alright?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
I'll go tell Dad and the others.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You can take your time. Let me see how it turns out!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, An!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This trip was so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (When we first arrived in the United States, I was so anxious and excited I could barely stop and see what was around me.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(But I'm really glad we came...
We had our share of troubles, but this trip ended up being really fun.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We got to see SONIC NOTES, and I got to talk to Taiga for the first time in a while.)
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hm...?
What's up, missy?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I wanted to thank you for that meal...!
Every dish was just so good!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Haha. Polite as ever, huh.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, I'm really glad that I got to hear you and An's dad sing during SONIC NOTES.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It made me realize just how lucky I was to learn from such an accomplished singer.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You're just realizing how great I am now? Took you long enough.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: N-No, that's not what I meant...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I just wanted to thank you for teaching me so much.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: No problem.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But let me just say this...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...?
Yes, what is it that you'd like to tell me?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: All I did was help you get to the starting line.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Sure, Ken's training might have helped a little.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But you're standing here now because you struggled against RUST and GLaP day, hung on for dear life and clawed your way to victory.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: In other words, this is the result of your hard work.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll be back in this country soon.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll have to decide what to do about school, and convince my parents... There's a lot to think about. But even so...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Our plan is to win RUSH BEATS and grab that slot to perform on the world's stage. To make our dream come true!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Good. Give it everything you've got.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Come to think of it, when I decided to pursue this seriously, I quit high school...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... Well... M-My dad might collapse if I did anything like that...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Haha. I wouldn't be surprised. You should've seen the look on my mom's face. I got an earful for making such a huge decision without asking anyone.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I have to do my best.
I need to give this journey everything that I have!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Okay, this photo looks nice.
Things do look a little different compared to when we first got here.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I wonder if things will look even more different next time.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (How will I have changed between now and the next time I come back?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Will I feel any different?
Will I have gotten better by then?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I have to keep growing.
I have to become twice as good. No, tenfold!)
